conclusion: No substantive defect found in the exact five-page theorem: the stated rate region is achievable in the asymptotic independent-message local-unitary split-receiver model with LOCC decoding and vanishing uniform average error. The claimed sum is a lower bound, not the optimal unrestricted LOCC capacity.
